items.en: Lying sadly in early spring in white lined clothes; the White Gate is desolate, many wishes go against me. The red tower looks cold across the rain; amidst pearl curtains and drifting lantern light, I return alone.

items.t: 紫泉宮殿鎖煙霞，欲取蕪城作帝家。  玉璽不緣歸日角，錦帆應是到天涯。
items.c: 紫泉宫殿锁烟霞，欲取芜城作帝家。  玉玺不缘归日角，锦帆应是到天涯。

items.en: The Purple Spring Palace is locked in mist and clouds; he wanted to make the weed-covered city his imperial home. If the Jade Seal hadn't gone to the Sun Horn, his brocade sails would have reached the ends of the earth.

items.t: 澹然空水對斜暉，曲島蒼茫接翠微。  波上馬嘶看棹去，柳邊人歇待船歸。
items.c: 澹然空水对斜晖，曲岛苍茫接翠微。  波上马嘶看棹去，柳边人歇待船归。

items.en: The tranquil, empty water faces the setting sun; winding islands blur into the green mountains. Horses neigh on the waves watching the oars depart; people rest by the willows waiting for the boat to return.

items.t: 蘇武魂銷漢使前，古祠高樹兩茫然。  雲邊雁斷胡天月，隴上羊歸塞草煙。
items.c: 苏武魂销汉使前，古祠高树两茫然。  云边雁断胡天月，陇上羊归塞草烟。

items.en: Su Wu's soul was consumed before the Han envoy; the ancient shrine and tall trees both look desolate. Geese are cut off at the clouds' edge under the barbarian moon; sheep return on the ridge amidst the border grass smoke.

items.t: 十二樓中盡曉妝，望仙樓上望君王。  鎖銜金獸連環冷，水滴銅龍晝漏長。
items.c: 十二楼中尽晓妆，望仙楼上望君王。  锁衔金兽连环冷，水滴铜龙昼漏长。

items.en: In the Twelve Towers, morning makeup is finished; on Wangxian Tower, they gaze for the King. The golden beast lock holds the ring coldly; water drips from the copper dragon, making the day seem long.

items.t: 蓬門未識綺羅香，擬託良媒益自傷。  誰愛風流高格調，共憐時世儉梳妝。
items.c: 蓬门未识绮罗香，拟托良媒益自伤。  谁爱风流高格调，共怜时世俭梳妆。

items.en: Living in a humble home, I've never known the scent of silk; planning to use a matchmaker only hurts me more. Who loves romantic elegance and high style? Everyone just pities the simple makeup of the times.
